name: Reachy
summary: An open-source humanoid torso — two 7-DOF arms, a 3-DOF 'Orbita' neck and an animated face — that mounts on a fixed stand or a mobile base and is designed for VR teleoperation and manipulation research. Pollen Robotics publishes the hardware and software openly; the company was acquired by Hugging Face in 2025, which pushed Reachy as an open robotics-and-AI platform.
notable: Fully open-source humanoid hardware and software
Adopted by Hugging Face as an open embodied-AI platform
